notes.title: (17/01/23) Update Notes
notes.notes:
Bug Fix: Fixed bug causing some enemies to perform incorrect animations.

Bug Fix: Fixed bug which prevented some achievements from unlocking correctly.

Bug Fix: Fixed bug which caused the Yellow status to behave incorrectly.

notes.title: (14/11) Update Notes
notes.notes:
Bug Fix: Fixed issue with an achievement not being awarded.

New collection screen in main menu to view all cards taken on previous runs.

Improved feedback to player from biome cards and buttons.

notes.notes:

Improved stability tier display pop up when adding or removing cards.
